title: Synthesis and Characterization of the New Tetrameric Magnesium Imide Compound [(thf)MgNSiPh<sub>3</sub>]<sub>4</sub>
abstract: AbstractReaction between di‐n‐butylmagnesium and the primary amine H2NSiPh3 affords the tetrameric magnesium imide [(thf)MgNSiPh3]4, representing the first example of a structurally characterized magnesium imide in which the group attached to the nitrogen is not aryl. The four Mg and N atoms are arranged in the form of a distorted heterocubane unit. (© Wiley‐VCH Verlag GmbH & Co. KGaA, 69451 Weinheim, Germany, 2008)
